description: Returns the command that writes the plan (backups first) and the operations it performs; this server never touches your disk. No drift: "nothing to apply". Refused on a credential-shaped source (no override over MCP), and on a compile that would not shrink the prefix unless force: true.

budget.description: token budget (default 60% of the file, at least 2000; a folder computes its own)

content.description: also return file contents, for a host without a shell

force.description: accept a compile that would not shrink the prefix

target.description: folder in the root, "." for itself; none: the recorded memory folder; never guess

name: apply
title: Compile or re-apply
